title: ConnectionError while pushing local changes (http.post)
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Executing Lattice 3.1.0 on Fedora 41 Workstation against us-west-2.

STEPS:

Steps to replicate:
* Open Lattice and begin pushing local changes.
* Run the stress script to generate load for about five minutes.
* Observe the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

No stack trace; pushing local changes usually takes a few secs.

ACTUAL:

After a few hundred calls every connection fails until the app is restarted. It
shows up under load; the connection count in the gauge keeps climbing and
not once drops.

FREQUENCY:

Happens roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:134 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:80 in sync_all
lattice/net/http.py:93 in post
ConnectionError: connection refused (host=us-west-2)
